name: yukoto-language-study

scripts.dev: node scripts/write-student-config.mjs && node scripts/prepare-curriculum.mjs && node scripts/prepare-journey.mjs && vite --host 0.0.0.0
scripts.build: node scripts/write-student-config.mjs && node scripts/prepare-curriculum.mjs && node scripts/prepare-journey.mjs && vite build
scripts.test: node scripts/test-curriculum.mjs && node --test scripts/test-rhiye.mjs && node scripts/test-guided.mjs && node scripts/test-journey-ui.mjs && node scripts/test-regressions.mjs
scripts.test:guided: node scripts/test-guided.mjs && node scripts/test-journey-ui.mjs && node scripts/test-regressions.mjs

description: Yukoto bilingual guided and free study with verified HSK 2.0/3.0 vocabulary and optional community JLPT import
